name: Tsunami
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You conjure a powerful wave at a point you choose within short range. Uncheck any number of Conditions. For each Condition you unchecked (twice for Insecure and Guilty), add 5 feet of thickness, 5 feet of height, and 10 ft of width to the wall.

Each creature within the wave when it appears must roll Strength against a Difficulty equal to the wave's height, in feet. On each failure, the creature takes 1d10 damage for every 5 ft of height the wave has, is knocked prone, and its Speed is reduced to 0 while it is within the wave. On each pass, half damage, and the creature may swim within the wave.

Whenever you sustain concentration on this spell, the wave moves 30 ft away from you. Any creature inside the wave or that enters the wave must roll Strength against its height, as above. After the wave finishes moving, its height is reduced by 5 ft. The spell ends when the wave's height reaches 0.

Describe the tsunami.
successes:
✨: Add an additional 5 feet of thickness, 5 feet of height, and 10 ft of width to the wave.

🌞: The wave's height is only reduced every other time it moves.
